trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Clear the other 54 trophies; all are offline. [2][3][4]
steps: Budget 60–80 hours for story, then roughly 100 for checklists and 10–20 for cleanup. [4][5]
Use the 15 manual slots to preserve chapter starts and endings; there is no mission replay or New Game Plus. [4][9][10]
Leave cheats off: they disable both trophies and saving for that session. [4][5]
Collect easy discoveries during the story, then use the post-story 100% checklist before the stranger and miscellaneous sweep. [4]

missable.reason: The platinum inherits the risks of its prerequisites; protect the Ch1 meditation. [4][9][10]

trophies.note: The list is single-player; the roadmap budgets about 200 hours. [4][5]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play Gone Fishing, the smuggling mission after the Prologue. [6][7]
steps: Start Chapter 1 with the Prologue, then follow Jason and Donnie into Gone Fishing. [6][7]
Follow the mission to completion; no medal or difficulty condition is attached to the award. [1][2]
Keep an early manual save so the later Chapter 1 meditation remains recoverable. [2][10]
Continue through Chapter 1 with a boundary save before Tourist Trap rather than relying on mission replay. [9][10]

missable.reason: Mandatory story award; the later balcony session is the opening chapter's trophy precaution. [2][9]

trophies.note: Both mission lists place Gone Fishing immediately after the Prologue. [6][7]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Ch1, then play What’s in the Bag? for the delayed notification. [2][3][7]
steps: Before leaving Chapter 1, accept Lucia's balcony meditation and finish any Shirley errands you want to keep. [2][9][10]
Expect Tourist Trap to chain into Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time without free roam between them. [9][10]
Finish Discharge Time, the end of the 22-mission opening chapter. [7][8]
Continue into What's in the Bag? in Port Gellhorn; a notification delayed into Ch2 is expected. [2][3][7]

missable.reason: Story trophy itself is safe. Keep the Chapter 1 save for the meditation window. [2][9][10]

trophies.note: The chapter-title trophy arrives after the next chapter's opening. [2][3][7]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Checking Out and continue through Welcome to Vice City. [2][3][7][8]
steps: Follow Chapter 2 through its finale, Checking Out, when the pair leave the motel. [7][8]
Use GAMES.GG's 11 main missions as the chapter index; other walkthroughs group side objectives differently. [6][7][8]
Keep $15,000+ saved before Checking Out; the Starlet Motel and a cabaret pool opponent become unavailable. [9]
Play Welcome to Vice City in Ch3 before diagnosing a missing Chapter 2 notification. [2][3][7]

missable.reason: Mandatory chapter progression; the motel loss is a convenience warning, not a trophy lock. [2][9]

trophies.note: The Ch3 title names the trophy awarded for Ch2. [2][3][7]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: After The Cartel Heist, complete Ch4’s first two missions. [2][3][7]
steps: Work through Chapter 3's 26 main missions; The Cartel Heist is its endpoint. [7][8]
Continue into Ocean Beach, where the pair check in at the Y, room 701. [8]
Play the short Another Life flashback after Ocean Beach. [8]
Allow both opening Ch4 missions to finish before troubleshooting the chapter trophy. [2][3][7]

missable.reason: Automatic story award; keep boundary saves for adjacent optional work. [2][9][10]

trophies.note: Guides agree the Chapter 3 trophy can pop after Ch4 has begun. [2][3][7]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Reach Starting From Zero at the Chapter 4 endpoint. [2][6][7]
steps: Keep a separate manual save before Chapter 4's last mission; there is no replay. [9][10]
Follow the Chapter 4 main chain through the airport-heist preparations and VCIA Takedown. [6][7]
Complete Starting From Zero, last in PowerPyx's Ch4 walkthrough; GAMES.GG redacts the 25th mission. [6][7]
Retain the boundary save into Chapter 5 because the story has multiple endings. [9][10]

missable.reason: Chapter completion is mandatory; the pre-ending save protects choice-dependent cleanup. [9][10]

trophies.note: PowerPyx names the endpoint; GAMES.GG's redacted final slot is consistent. [6][7]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete The End of the Road, the Chapter 5 finale. [6][8]
steps: Preserve a manual save before the final mission; endings depend on choices and there is no replay. [2][9][10]
Finish any partner or character-specific jobs first as a precaution, not a proven post-ending lock. [9]
Follow the Chapter 5 chain to The End of the Road, the last mission in both walkthroughs. [6][8]
Use the walkthrough chapter placement rather than the Chapter 4 label in PowerPyx's trophy page. [2][6][7][8]

missable.reason: Story completion award; pre-finale backups protect optional work and ending choices. [9][10]

trophies.note: Method agreed; PowerPyx's trophy-page chapter label contradicts its walkthrough. [2][6][8]

disputes.a: PowerPyx trophy guide labels the final mission Chapter 4. [2]
disputes.b: Its own walkthrough and OutputLag put The End of the Road in Chapter 5. [6][8]
disputes.verdict: Use Chapter 5. Finish the story either way; retain a pre-finale save.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run, the mandatory partner-robbery mission. [2][3][8]
steps: Follow Chapter 2 to Breakfast Run, main mission #8 in the GAMES.GG index. [7][8]
During the robberies, one partner handles the crowd while the other empties registers. [2][3][8]
Complete the mission normally; no additional medal requirement is listed. [1][2]
Expect character switching around Breakfast Run / Coffee Break: the guides describe adjacent unlock moments. [8][11]

missable.reason: Mandatory story route; partner free roam follows around this part of Ch2. [2][8][11]

trophies.note: The robbery mission is agreed; switching is described after breakfast or coffee. [2][3][8][11]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Follow Raul’s preparations into the Sinfrontera National Bank heist. [6][7][8]
steps: Begin with scouting Sinfrontera National Bank and the Security Expert preparation. [6][8]
Continue Company Property and Safe Word, including taking Gil's safe under the pool-maintenance cover. [6][8]
Complete The Missing Link and Hidden Charges before the heist; the latter places charges at cell towers. [6][8]
Finish The Cartel Heist at Chapter 3's end; this is separate from free-roam bank-vault tracking. [1][2][7][8]

missable.reason: Main-chain heist, not the five-vault cleanup award. [1][2]

trophies.note: Three mission lists identify The Cartel Heist as the Ch3 finale. [6][7][8]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child’s Play in Chapter 4, then watch for Shayna’s timed call. [2][6][9]
steps: Follow the main Chapter 4 chain to Child's Play, mission #17 in the main-mission index. [6][7]
Carry out the rescue job for Rafa described by the walkthrough. [2][6]
Complete the story mission; no optional medal is required. [1][2]
Afterward, answer This is a Free Call From… as Lucia and pick up Shayna immediately; it is timed. [6][9]

missable.reason: The trophy is mandatory; the follow-up Shayna call is the timed opportunity. [6][9]

trophies.note: Child's Play is mandatory; the warning concerns its optional timed follow-up. [2][6][9]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, the Dimez launch-party story mission. [2][3][6]
steps: Continue the Chapter 4 chain after Child's Play into Headliners. [6][7]
Find it at #18 in the GAMES.GG chapter index, not as an optional stranger strand. [6][7]
Help with the Dimez performance at VYB and finish the launch-party mission. [2][3][6]
Let the mandatory mission end; the award arrives automatically without a medal chase. [2][3]

missable.reason: Main story mission; no optional branch requirement documented. [2][3]

trophies.note: The main lists agree on the Chapter 4 performance mission. [2][3][6][7]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the airport heist VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. [2][3][7]
steps: Follow Making Gainz, Too Much Baggage, Watch It and Amateur Hour in the prep chain. [6]
Continue Cash Injections, Dirty Work, Close Surveillance and Delivery Method. [6]
Finish Team Building, Fully Catered and Heist Plans in Place before the airport operation. [6]
Complete VCIA Takedown, Chapter 4 mission #23; stealing a free-roam jet is a different trophy. [2][3][7]

missable.reason: Mandatory heist; no link to the optional passenger-jet escape. [2]

trophies.note: Mission name and chapter placement agree across the trophy lists. [2][3][7]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory late in the main story. [2][3][7]
steps: Continue into Chapter 5; Operation Savage Glory is #5 of the seven-main-mission index. [6][7]
Follow the mandatory shipment-recovery operation rather than looking for an optional marker. [2][3][7]
Complete the operation through the story; no additional performance target is listed. [2][3]
Keep the pre-finale save intact as you approach The End of the Road. [2][9][10]

missable.reason: Automatic progression award near the finale. [2][3]

trophies.note: Both primary guides and the chapter index put the operation in Ch5. [2][3][7]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, use Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; earlier work counts. [2][3][4]
steps: Open the checklist after the credits; free-roam requirements remain available. [4][9][10][20]
Push beyond trophy targets: 300 stunts, 30 races, 70 challenges, 15 card sets and eight vaults. [4][5][20]
Keep the meditation targets separate: the checklist asks for 15, but its trophy asks for 18. [4][5][11][20]
Clear all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs and seven payday jobs; fence $250k in marked bills. [4][20]
Audit remaining collections: 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries and 200 of 277 base vehicle models. [4][20]

missable.reason: No required 100% item is reported lost after the story. [2][9][10]

trophies.note: The checklist deliberately requires a subset of true completion, with different trophy thresholds. [4][5][20]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Mix stunt types; under-bridge flights are the recommended fast option. [2][3][5]
steps: Choose among 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. [2][3][4]
Use under-bridge flights to build the total without relying solely on stunt jumps. [2][3][5]
Stop at 250 for the trophy, but carry on to 300 if working toward 100%. [4][5][20]
Leave the hardest stunts aside: the 397 available give substantial choice over which 250 or 300 to finish. [2][3][4]

missable.reason: Free-roam checklist work remains after the story. [9][10]

trophies.note: The trophy and completion checklist use different totals from the same stunt pool. [4][5][20]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try the nine activity types, then inspect Progress > Activities. [2][3][16]
steps: Start with fishing, pool, hunting and a basketball hoop. [2][3][16]
Add mini golf, a video game and a shooting-range challenge. [2][3][16]
Try racing or a drone/race challenge, plus a stunt, to cover the remaining types. [2][3][16]
Use Progress > Activities to identify gaps rather than repeating completed types. [2][16]

missable.reason: Activity types can be revisited in free roam. [2][9]

trophies.note: OutputLag enumerates the same nine types covered by the trophy guides. [2][3][16]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit Griffin and Rodgers Ranch: two venues, 12 courses, 42 golds. [12][16]
steps: Buy each $5 Waiver Pass. Rent a weapon for ~$10 if needed. [12][16]
At Griffin, use Lucia for speed. Bullseyes save a second. [12][16]
At Rodgers Ranch, build body-shot multipliers before weak-point hits. Avoid misses. [12][16]
Finish 18 Griffin + 24 Rodgers golds. Range runs grow Focus permanently. [12][16]

missable.reason: Repeatable challenges. No chapter gate is documented. [12][16]

trophies.note: Two venues, not 12: courses and venues were confused in earlier readings. [12][16]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win once at each of 14 locations; all 42 trials are for 100%. [2][3][4][13]
steps: Filter Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones; blue icons appear nearby and Progress > Activities tracks them. [13][16]
At each site, beat the first two par times to unlock its third trial. [13][16]
The third trial needs only a finish; keep left stick forward and favour clean lines over risky shortcuts. [13][16]
For the trophy, ensure all 14 locations have a win. For 100%, finish the entire 42-trial set. [2][3][4][13]

missable.reason: Repeatable free-roam activity; no loss window reported. [9][10][13]

trophies.note: The distinction is one win per location versus every trial for completion. [4][13]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win unique events, not repeats; choose 20 from the 40 available. [2][3][4][14]
steps: After Dealer's Choice in Ch3, follow the Hit 'N Run VC group-chat invitation. [6][14]
Use Map > Activities > Racing and Progress > Activities > Racing to find unfinished events. [14][16]
Rotate events: a repeated win does not advance the unique-race total. [2][3][14]
Finish 20 for the trophy, then 30 for the completion checklist; race-challenge golds are separate. [4][5][14]

missable.reason: Normal race events are repeatable; Yago's timed side mission is a separate risk. [6][9][14]

trophies.note: Unique wins are agreed; the 100% target exceeds the trophy by ten. [4][5][14]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Feng Shui, follow Cal’s text to the purple fishing marker. [2][3]
steps: Advance Chapter 1 through Feng Shui before expecting Cal's fishing invitation. [2][3]
Use the fishing spot sent by Cal rather than treating any fish catch as the challenge. [2][3]
Complete the house repairs, buy the long gun and repair the Ganado at Joey's to reach Feng Shui's call. [8]
Work on other activity types while waiting for the invitation; fishing is one of the nine activity categories. [2][16]

missable.reason: The challenge is available early; no expiration is reported. [2][3]

trophies.note: Both trophy guides agree on Cal's invitation after Feng Shui. Detailed fish instructions need the separate fishing source. [2][3]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the ending of one video game; simply starting it is insufficient. [2][3]
steps: Use Jason's home console in Ch1 or an arcade cabinet to begin a game. [2][4][16]
Finish every level of your chosen game rather than only playing one round. [2][3]
If the house is unavailable during most of Ch2, use cabinets or wait for access to return in Ch3. [9][10]
For 100%, play all four games; the trophy only requires finishing one. [2][4][16]

missable.reason: Console access returns; arcade cabinets provide an alternative. [9][10]

trophies.note: Full-game completion and temporary house access are distinct requirements. [2][3][9][10]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: As Lucia, follow Andy’s invitation in Ch3 through Puff Puff Pass. [2][3][6]
steps: Answer Andy's invitation to Belville as Lucia once Chapter 3 is open. [2][3][6]
Follow the Cellerica initiation jobs, then Read the Label's van recovery and Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse. [2][6]
Do not count this chain toward Strangers & Freaks; it has its own trophy. [2][6]
The guides report it remains after the story, but finish character-specific chains before the finale as a precaution. [2][3][9]

missable.reason: Post-story availability reported; pre-finale advice is precautionary. [2][3][9]

trophies.note: Lucia-only Andy chain and final mission are documented, separately from stranger strands. [2][3][6]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton’s purple treasure markers; his Chapter 1 absence is temporary. [2][3][9][10]
steps: After Island Dreams, answer Kenton's invitation and find the KR marker in Key Lento. [2][3][6][9]
Dive at the marked chest sites and recover the treasures across seven shipwrecks. [2][4]
If Kenton disappears at the Ch1 boundary, wait for his Ch2/3 return; calling Brian as Jason can bring him back sooner. [2][3][9][10]
For 100%, track five of seven treasure sets and all 33 underwater discoveries separately. [2][4][20]

missable.reason: Kenton returns in Ch2/3; the pause is not a permanent loss. [9][10]

trophies.note: Multiple sources explicitly resolve the temporary disappearance. [2][3][9][10]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Visit Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break and finish Billy’s jobs. [2][3][6][8]
steps: After Coffee Break in Ch2, visit the Mudclub in Kelly County to begin Thrillbillies. [2][3][6][8]
Follow Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats and The Impaler toward the final job. [6][8]
For The Impaler, check the red Imponte Phoenix on the tow truck at the Ambrosia impound before leaving. [6][8]
Finish Hometown Heroes; Billy remains after the story and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks. [2][3][6]

missable.reason: The chain remains available after the story. [2][3]

trophies.note: The chain begins after Coffee Break and ends at Hometown Heroes. [2][3][6][8]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying strands; only Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are securely identified. [2][3][6]
steps: Start Kirk from the Skunk Ape flyer in Ch1 and Kyle from the pilot flyer in Ch2; their chains span chapters. [6]
In Ch3, do Race Against Yago immediately when its hourglass appears; preserve a save before it. [6][9][10]
Begin Pilot Pete's Jason-only jobs in Ch4, then follow the package-delivery chain. [6]
Check the PS5 trophy counter after each full strand; the other four qualifying strands are not confirmed. [2][3][6]
Do not count Andy, Billy, Kenton, Bret or Tyrone toward this total; they have separate awards. [2][6]

missable.reason: Race Against Yago is timed in Ch3. Do it on appearance; do not postpone to this cleanup stage. Shayna’s Ch4 call is timed too. [6][9][10]

trophies.note: Four counting strands are documented; the remaining four are unknown. [2][6]

disputes.topic: Can timed work affect the trophy?
disputes.a: The trophy page says timed tasks do not affect trophies. [2]
disputes.b: The walkthrough and both missable guides flag Yago's timed race. [6][9][10]
disputes.verdict: Treat Yago as at risk. Save and complete it immediately.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS, deliver Randy’s requested cars and finish his closing job. [2][3][6]
steps: Reach the mid-Ch3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to obtain the Key Cloner and unlock Randy's list. [2][3][6]
Scan cars with WAiNK to identify wish-list vehicles before taking them. [2][3]
Follow Randy's marked drop-offs and reminders toward his west Vice City RK garage. [2]
Watch the trophy counter at 16 deliveries; the dossier also records an 18-car wish list, so list size is not assumed to equal trophy target. [2][3]

missable.reason: No expiration window is reported for Randy’s chain. [2][3]

trophies.note: The chain is confirmed; 16 is the trophy target, not a claim about full wish-list size. [2][3]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, follow Tyrone’s jobs after Here, Kitty Kitty and shut down the labs. [2][3][6][8]
steps: Finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 to open Tyrone's Jason-only side work. [2][3][6][8]
Destroy the marked Kitty Litter Labs at the purple Synthetic Lab markers. [2][6][9]
Finish the closing mission Shut Down the Labs after the marked lab jobs. [2][6]
Use Tyrone as a fence in La Perle when useful; his chain is not a qualifying stranger strand. [2][6][17]

missable.reason: Reported available after the story; character-specific work is safest before the ending. [2][6][9]

trophies.note: Unlock mission, Jason restriction and lab finale are documented. [2][3][6][8]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Take Lucia’s Ch1 balcony invitation, then visit outdoor spots with both characters. [4][9][11]
steps: After Down to Earth, speak to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony. [2][3][4][9][11]
Accept the optional meditation before Tourist Trap. Its necessity is unconfirmed; do it as insurance. [4][9][10][11]
After Coffee Break, use both characters at outdoor spots; each can add a session. [4][11]
Track Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The Ascent Mountain finale appears after the other meditations. [11]
Keep the Ch1 save until the trophy unlocks: trophy target 18, completion-checklist target 15. [2][4][9][11]

missable.reason: Only possibly missable step: the balcony session before Tourist Trap. Whether it is strictly required is unconfirmed. Keep your Ch1 save. [4][9][10][11]

trophies.note: 18 sessions across 10 spots; balcony necessity uncertain, so protect it. [4][9][11]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret’s chain is known; the animal that triggers this trophy is not. [3][4][5]
steps: As Jason, watch for Bret's text after Coffee Break; Lucia cannot take this chain. [2][3][6]
Complete Bret's marked hunts and track his 15 Target Decks separately for 100%. [2][4]
Do not assume a species or guaranteed spawn: no read source confirms the trophy-triggering animal. [3][4][5]

missable.reason: Trigger and missable window unknown. Finish Jason-only work before the ending as a precaution. [3][4][5][9]

trophies.note: Chain availability is documented, but no source identifies the unique trophy animal. [3][4][5]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish three entire card sets; three loose cards will not satisfy it. [2][3]
steps: Use Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to inspect incomplete sets. [2][3]
Work toward whole-set completion, not a raw count of three cards. [2][3]
Carry on to 15 of 18 sets for 100%, leaving three difficult sets out of the completion route. [4][5][20]
Keep the set counter separate from WAiNK locations and vehicle discoveries, which have their own collection targets. [2][3][4]

missable.reason: Completion collections remain available in post-story free roam. [9][10]

trophies.note: Three sets is the trophy threshold, while 15 sets is the completion threshold. [4][5][20]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app on location objects, not the vehicle-discovery counter. [2][3][4]
steps: Scan location objects with WAiNK and monitor the locations total as you explore. [2][3]
Reach 100 location scans; that same threshold also satisfies the 100% requirement. [2][3][4]
Check Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations for the per-set breakdown. [2]
Do not substitute vehicle scans: Whip It Good tracks those separately. [2][3]

missable.reason: No scan-unlock chapter is stated; collection work remains available after the story. [9][10]

trophies.note: 100 location scans is agreed. No chapter gate is asserted. [2][3][4]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Choose any 50 of 80 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70. [2][3][4][15]
steps: Open Progress > Challenges; completed tasks show a checkmark when inspected. [15]
Pick across Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle categories. [15]
Begin with easy overlap such as gym membership or scanning four landmarks, curiosities or sculptures. [15]
Let other trophies complete tasks naturally, then grind the gaps; reserve 70 total for the 100% route. [2][4][15]

missable.reason: Challenges are available from the start and allow a choice of tasks. [15]

trophies.note: The 50/70 trophy-versus-completion split is independently described. [4][5][15]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner, lose four stars, then leave the red heat zone. [2][3]
steps: After Coffee Break, bring your partner before starting the four-star chase. [2][3]
Use a bank-vault job to generate the wanted level and combine awards if convenient. [2][17]
Keep escaping after active pursuit ends: the award waits for leaving the red heat zone. [2][3]
Change clothes and car after the chase and stay outside the heat zone to avoid recognition. [17]

missable.reason: Failed attempts can be retried. Finish partner jobs before the finale as a precaution. [9]

trophies.note: Losing police and clearing residual heat are separate parts of the agreed method. [2][3]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob nearby shops with your partner while the wanted stars stay active. [2][3][17]
steps: Bring your partner and plan a short route among clustered shops before the first robbery. [2][5][17]
Keep active wanted stars between all three robberies; residual heat alone does not preserve the chain. [2][3]
Allow about 30 seconds after the third shop; if no award appears, try a fourth shop. [2][3][5]
Expect a rapid police response; armour, healing supplies and a ready bike help the getaway. [17]

missable.reason: Retry failed chains; finish partner work before the ending only as a precaution. [9]

trophies.note: Continuous active stars matter; notification delay is documented. [2][3][5]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan new vehicle models; you need not drive them. [2][3]
steps: Scan new traffic with the phone instead of stealing each model. [2][3]
Aim for 100 discoveries for the trophy, then keep scanning toward 200 for 100%. [2][4][20]
Use 277 as the base-model pool; a larger total includes variants, not extra base models. [4][20]
Include boats and aircraft in your discovery sweep rather than limiting scans to road vehicles. [20]

missable.reason: Discoveries can accumulate during the story and continue afterward. [4][9][10]

trophies.note: Scanning is sufficient; 100 trophy discoveries and 200 completion discoveries are distinct. [2][3][4][20]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use a full Focus bar and an assault rifle against a group of gang members. [2][3][5]
steps: Build Focus through shooting-range runs first; each run raises it permanently. [2][12][16]
Find gang members for the attempt; cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count. [2][5]
While aiming, click both sticks to activate Combat Focus and down the group with an assault rifle. [2][3]
Keep all five takedowns inside one activation; separate Focus uses cannot be combined. [2][3]

missable.reason: Repeatable combat attempt. Training Focus first reduces the execution pressure. [2][16]

trophies.note: Gang targets and a single activation are the useful constraints, not an arbitrary kill counter. [2][3][5]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Take a passenger jet from a VCIA boarding bridge and fly roughly 1 km away. [2][3][5]
steps: Find a large passenger jet attached to a boarding bridge at VCIA, with E3 or E4 documented. [2][3]
Use the bridge-docked jet rather than assuming any parked aircraft satisfies the method. [2][3]
Back out, take off and continue about 1 km away before expecting the notification. [2][3][5]
Treat this as a free-roam departure, separate from the mandatory VCIA Takedown heist. [2]
